facts.fact: The Internet Society Pulse IXP Tracker, drawing on PeeringDB self-reported data, lists the Angola Internet Exchange Point (angonix) in Luanda as active with 23 members, at one physical location, as of June 2026; Pulse says 86% of Angola's 63 active networks are members or customers of members of an IXP.

The Internet Society Pulse IXP Tracker, drawing on PeeringDB self-reported data, lists a second exchange, Angola IXP, in Luanda as active with 14 members at three physical locations, as of June 2026; the page counts 2 active IXPs with a combined 29 members.

systems.country_label: Angola Internet Exchange point - Angola IXP

note: Both exchanges are in Luanda (IXPs present in 1 of 14 population centres over 300,000), so no reach:wider fact; the page does not state members are local only, so no reach:none fact; no traffic, content or growth figures.
